hypothesis: Structured target and neutral persona providers can realize a cognitive plan through the same local-model surface path without reaching legacy fixed reply families, while the default and explicit legacy providers remain behaviorally identical.

conditions.structured_target: structured target public-persona policy plus strict local-model surface generation
conditions.structured_neutral: equal-shape neutral policy plus the same strict local-model surface generation
conditions.explicit_legacy: explicit legacy provider using the same deterministic surface behavior

controls: same candidate count and decoding schedule
same semantic and surface candidate gates
no benchmark, holdout, target utterance, or production memory access
failure_conditions: a structured condition calls a legacy template, fallback, enrichment, speech-variant, or dynamic-anchor surface producer
a structured condition returns a deterministic fixed reply when the model is missing or every candidate is rejected
target and neutral conditions use different compute schedules
default and explicit legacy runtime outputs differ
any benchmark or target-person utterance is used as a construction fixture
